# ProtoPeek

ProtoPeek (Protocol Peek) is a lightweight local-first protocol and network workbench and independent open source project by Shreyam Adhikari. The current source keeps native gRPC and bounded HTTP request surfaces alongside separate DNS, read-only kernel-route, Linux-native consented UDP hop, authorized private-network selected-TCP, logical topology, and offline Nmap XML evidence. Darwin/Windows active-hop backends, broader range expansion, and live capture remain future or gated work.

Primary site: https://protopeek.shreyam1008.com.np/
Author: https://shreyam1008.com.np/
Repository: https://github.com/shreyam1008/ProtoPeek
Release status: v0.4.0 is the current stable release. The verified release resolver and owned Homebrew/Scoop channels publish its independently tested checksum-pinned archives.

Summary:
- Launch ProtoPeek with no target and define one or more saved gRPC endpoints from the UI.
- Explore proto files, services, messages, enums, dependencies, and export raw `.proto` text.
- Generate starter JSON payloads from reflected schemas.
- Inspect metadata, trailers, status, callback-observed lifecycle timing, and explicit canonical Health; use bounded sequential repetition only as a local diagnostic.
- Send explicit HTTP(S) requests with method, URL, params, headers, auth, body, timeout, cancellation, redirect choice, and native response evidence.
- On Linux, authorize a fixed native UDP path plan and inspect pinned DNS, kernel-route, silent-hop, and per-responder source RTT evidence. A destination median uses only exact pinned-address replies, never the last responding router or per-link latency.
- Preview and authorize one RFC 1918 IPv4 `/24`-or-smaller discovery. Exact `applicationProbePorts` are Quick `80,443,50051,8080`; gRPC `443,6565,7000,7443,9090,50051`; Web `80,443,3000,4000,5000,8000,8080,8443`; Expanded `80,443,3000,8000,8080,8443,9090,50051`. They may receive bounded gRPC reflection and non-following HTTP `HEAD /`; Expanded `22,53,445,631,1883,3306,3389,5432,6379,9100` are TCP-connect-only.
- Discovery's 64 KiB aggregate verbose-detail budget retains every observed open-port record. `probeDurationMs` is full probe duration, not network latency.
- Save immutable snapshots while preserving manual labels, tags, notes, pinned positions, groups, services, and relationships across later observations; unsaved edits are guarded until explicitly saved or discarded.
- Use canonical `protopeek-network` JSON for lossless exchange, disclosed-loss GraphML for graph exchange, and CSV for flat inventory export.
- Keep automatic history and default exports secret-safe while each adapter preserves its native request and response concepts.
- Install with Homebrew (`brew install shreyam1008/tap/protopeek`), Scoop (`scoop bucket add shreyam https://github.com/shreyam1008/scoop-bucket` then `scoop install shreyam/protopeek`), or the checksum-verifying shell/PowerShell release resolvers.
